summary: Lazily initializes an audio resource: if the interface pointer global dword_8AC4C4 is set and the cached result global dword_8AC4CC is still zero, calls the object's vtable method located 96 bytes past the vtable base and stores its return value into dword_8AC4CC. Runs once per process lifetime in practice. Invoked by Sound_Enter.

operations.description: Guard on dword_8AC4C4 being nonzero; the whole body is skipped when the interface pointer is not yet established.
Guard on dword_8AC4CC being zero; the initialization runs only once and is skipped once a result has been cached.
Indirect call through the vtable of the object referenced by dword_8AC4C4; the target is read at 96 bytes past the vtable base (slot for the lazy-create entry point).
Store the method return value into dword_8AC4CC, memoizing the result.
Invoked by Sound_Enter during sound subsystem entry.

unresolved: The concrete object type behind dword_8AC4C4 is unknown; only its vtable indirection is visible.
The purpose of the vtable method at offset 96 and the meaning of its integer return value are undocumented here.
